title: Find Single Unique Element - Solution
approach: XOR all elements in the array to find the single element.
intuition: Given a non-empty array of integers where every element appears twice except for one, find that single one.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: XOR all elements in the array to find the single element.
common_mistakes: XOR of a number with itself is 0.
XOR of any number with 0 is the number itself.
